newsitem.title: UK: Triplex Lloyd posts offer for W.Cook.
newsitem.headline: Triplex Lloyd posts offer for W.Cook.

text.p: British engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc on Friday formally posted the offer document for its hostile takeover bid for steel firm William Cook Plc.

In a statement, Triplex said that since it announced its cash and shares offer a week ago an increase in its own share price had efffectively increased the value of the bid to about 312.9 pence from 309 pence, or 57.7 million stg, last Friday.

Triplex Lloyd chief executive Graham Lockyer said in the statement the firm was "delighted at the favourable reception we have received for our offer as evidenced by the strengthening of Triplex Lloyd's share price."
